items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I have a brother who is an offspring of her second husband -- Paul

ctx.x: Yeah. Did your mother marry again after your father died?
Yes, she married again and I have a brother who is an offspring of her second husband -- Paul, he lives in Braddock now, he's three years younger than I am and he --
Was Williams the surname of the second husband?
